post.summary: Отправить сообщение агенту и получить ответ
Exchange an API key for a short-lived Studio session token

config.description: The live configuration. Open-ended by design.

source.description: Where the configuration came from (currently always "runtime").

AgentConfigDto.description:
Response shape for `GET /api/config`.
    The endpoint returns an anonymous object, so the OpenAPI document described
nothing and Studio had to hand-write ConfigDto. The live configuration
itself is RuntimeConfigStore.Current, whose keys are open-ended — it is
exposed as a JSON object rather than a closed set of members.

fingerprint.description: Non-reversible identifier used to address this key in the write endpoints.

label.description:
Display-only hint about the key's shape (e.g. `hc_sys_…`). Derived from the
prefix before the random token, never from the token itself.

ApiKeySummaryDto.description:
One API key as exposed to Studio. The raw key is **never** included — a key the
browser cannot read is one the browser cannot leak. Keys are addressed by
string ApiKeySummaryDto.Fingerprint, a non-reversible id, so Studio can edit and delete a key
it has never seen the value of.

currentFingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the key backing the calling session, if any.

CanaryRequest.description: Request to deploy a canary package.

CodeScanRequest.description: Stage 3.5 — scan-only request for the sandbox's dangerous-code rules.

reasons.description: Human-readable reason, e.g. ``File.Delete` matched at line 42`.

lineNumbers.description: 1-based line numbers, parallel to IReadOnlyList<string> CodeScanResponseDto.Reasons.

CodeScanResponseDto.description:
Result of `DangerousCodeScanner` over a snippet.
    Mirrors DangerousCodeScanner.ScanResult, which stops at the first match — so
IReadOnlyList<string> CodeScanResponseDto.Reasons and IReadOnlyList<int> CodeScanResponseDto.LineNumbers are parallel lists of one entry
rather than every violation.

ConsensusAnswerDto.description: One agent's answer as stored in a consensus session.

ConsensusSessionDto.description: A stored consensus round (Stage 7.8). Answers are kept verbatim.

budgetUsedPct.description: Used share of the budget, one decimal. 0 when no budget is configured.

ContextBudgetDto.description:
Response shapes for the context / distillation endpoints (Stage 6.6).
Named so Studio's generated client can describe them.

key.description:
Optional operator-supplied key. When omitted the agent generates one and returns
it **once** in ApiKeySummaryDto CreatedApiKeyResponseDto.Key — it is not retrievable afterwards.

generatedKey.description: Plaintext key, present only when the agent generated it.

CreatedApiKeyResponseDto.description:
A newly created key. ApiKeySummaryDto CreatedApiKeyResponseDto.Key is the only time the value is ever returned —
it is not stored in the browser and cannot be re-read through any endpoint.

DelegatedTaskStateUpdateRequest.description: Запрос на обновление состояния delegated задачи (task_036).

ForceCheckOutRequestDto.description: DTO для force-checkout (опциональный `by` — actor для audit-лога).

args.description: Process arguments for `stdio` transport. Empty for http/sse.

endpoint.description: Absolute URL for `http`/`sse` transport. Null for `stdio`.

McpServerDefinitionDto.description:
The *configured* shape of one MCP server, mirroring `McpServerConfig`.
Studio edits this and writes it back through `PATCH /api/config`, which
triggers `McpClientService`'s diff-driven hot-reload — there is no
dedicated add/remove endpoint because the config store is the write surface.

McpServerSummaryDto.description:
Response shapes for the MCP endpoints (Stage 0: named so Studio's generated
client can describe them; the endpoints previously returned anonymous objects
and produced no schema).

Stage 5b additionally carries McpServerDefinitionDto McpServerSummaryDto.Config so the editor can round-trip
a server without a second, separately-typed read endpoint.

circuitState.description: Rendered from the `CircuitState` enum so the document stays schema-able.

MeshRouteCandidateDto.description:
Response shapes for the mesh routing query (Stage 6.4).
    GET /api/mesh/router/routes answers "which peers would serve capability X,
and on what basis" — the scores, trust verdict and circuit state that produced the
ranking. Surfaced in Studio as a routing inspector.

PendingApprovalsResponseDto.description:
Response shapes for the human-in-the-loop endpoints (approvals and escalations).
    Stage 0: Studio's client is generated from the agent's OpenAPI document. Endpoints
returning anonymous objects produce no response schema, so Studio's types were
hand-written and could drift silently. These named shapes let the endpoints
declare themselves via .Produces<T>(200) without changing the JSON.
    Non-nullable members use required: without it the emitter omits them from the
schema's required array and every field generates as optional, so the client
stops reflecting what the agent actually serialises.

PromoteCanaryRequest.description: Request to promote a canary to full deployment.

QuotaStatusDto.description:
Response shape for `GET /api/quotas` (Stage 6.5).
    IQuotaService is read-only — limits live in AppConfig.Quotas. An
"editor" therefore means writing the quotas section via
PATCH /api/config, which the Studio config view already does. This DTO
exists so the live status can be generated rather than hand-written.

event.description: Event type: fallback, usercorrection, safetydenial, latencysample.

by.description: Опциональный actor для audit-лога (по умолчанию берётся из ApiKeyMiddleware).

reason.description: Опциональная причина рестарта (operator-supplied), попадает в audit и status response.

RollbackPackageRequest.description: Request to rollback a skill package.

code.description: Source to execute (a file-based C# skill under test, or an editor snippet).

skillId.description: Optional skill this run relates to, for correlation in the UI.

SaveConsensusSessionRequest.description: Request to record a consensus round.

SkillPromptRevisionDto.description:
Response shapes for skill prompt history (Stage 2: the diff view needs a
previous version; the agent previously discarded prompt history entirely).

StudioSessionResponseDto.description:
Response shapes for the Studio endpoints added by ADR-0009.
    These were written after the codegen pipeline existed, so they are named from
the start: an undeclared response shape is exactly the drift that made
Studio's client hand-written and wrong.

ToolSummaryDto.description:
Response shapes for the tool registry.
    ADR / Stage 0: the agent's OpenAPI document is the input to Studio's generated
client. Endpoints returning anonymous objects cannot be described, so
GET /api/tools had no response schema at all and full client codegen was
impossible. Naming the shape here lets the endpoint declare it via
.Produces<T>(200) without changing the serialized JSON.

TrustAdmissionDryRunRequest.description:
Request для dry-run evaluation of trust admission policy (task_040).
Allows callers to test a policy decision without actually sending an intent.

role.description: Optional new role; null leaves the current role untouched.

description.description: Optional new description; null leaves the current description untouched.

UpdatePackageRequest.description: Request to update a skill package on target agent(s).

ApiKey.description: API key with a role (contribute | system). See WebApi:ApiKeys.
ApiKey.name: X-Api-Key
